svg.title: DUET headline results
svg.desc: Animated results on Qwen3-1.7B-Base trained on MATH. (a) Time to finish 232 training steps relative to full-budget GRPO, with MATH-500 mean@4: DUET at 50% budget 0.40x (62.1), DUET 0.62x (61.6), ARRoL 0.77x (58.4), GRPO 1.00x (56.8), VIP 1.05x (58.6), DAPO 1.23x (57.6). (b) DUET lead over the strongest baseline grows as the budget tightens: +3.0 at 100% (61.6 vs VIP 58.6), +3.6 at 50% (62.1 vs ARRoL 58.5), +4.3 at 25% (61.4 vs ARRoL 57.1), while DUET runs 1.62x, 2.51x and 3.4x faster than full-budget GRPO.
svg.text: DUET at half the rollout budget: 2.51× faster and +5.3 MATH-500 vs. full-budget GRPO
Qwen3-1.7B-Base trained on MATH · mean@4 accuracy (%) · wall-clock on the same 8×H100 node and engine
(a) Same 232 training steps — who finishes first, and how good is the model?
wall-clock = time to finish, relative to full-budget GRPO (lower is better) · Table 1
(b) The tighter the budget, the bigger DUET’s lead
gap = DUET − best of GRPO / DAPO / ARRoL / VIP at that budget
speed = wall-clock vs. full-budget GRPO · Tables 1 & 5, Fig. 3b
